## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo build` succeeds
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (including `.vibe` suites)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes
- [ ] Language changes update `docs/language.vibe.txt` and `README.md`
- [ ] New built-ins have tests and documentation
- [ ] No secrets, `target/` or `.azra/packages/` are committed (rebuild
      `playground/azra.wasm` if the runtime changed)
- [ ] Commit messages follow the Conventional Commits rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Related issues

Closes #

## Notes for reviewers

Anything the owner should pay particular attention to.
